review_evidence: BetacPc.lean:310 lines - defines pToBeta/betaToP bijections, proves strict monotonicity, betaC definition and critical point correspondence
Coloring.lean:269 lines - defines Compatible colorings, monoBool, disagreeEdges, proves cardinality of compatible configurations = q^numClusters
CorrelationMonotone.lean:364 lines - proves covariance non-negativity via GKS2, derives monotonicity of two-point functions and magnetization in beta
EsInfinite.lean:287 lines - relates fvMagnetization to infinite-volume magnetization via subsequences, connects to fkTheta
EsLatticeBridge.lean:121 lines - proves wired FK weight/Z/prob equal boundary condition variants on boundaryCliqueGraph
EsWired.lean:518 lines - develops wired ES measure with BoundaryFixed, proves marginals = wired Potts/FK, establishes constOnWiredEquiv
FvES.lean:495 lines - proves esWiredOnePoint = wiredConnToBdryProb, connects Ising one-point to FK boundary connection
HisingBoxClose.lean:495 lines - establishes hbx_hisingBox (fvMagnetization = esWiredOnePoint on box), proves phase transition theorems
IsingBoxEncoding.lean:389 lines - defines latToBox/boxToLat equivalence, proves weight/energy correspondences, sum reindexing
LongRangeOrderAssembly.lean:83 lines - abstract lemma: long-range order above critical point, spatial decay below
MagPercoId.lean:261 lines - defines boundaryConnProfile, proves magPercoId_of_fvES (magnetization = fkTheta) via fvES/fkLim
MagPercoIdBox.lean:353 lines - boxBoundaryConnProfile via wiredConnToBdryProb, proves magPercoIdBox_final for general d
MagnetizationCorrespondence.lean:388 lines - mfc_magPercoId connecting box profiles to FK theta, mfc_htransition/ising_transition
MagnetizationFK.lean:295 lines - proves fv_integral_origin_nonneg via GKS kernel, magnetization_nonneg for all beta>=0
PcUpperAllDimensions.lean:585 lines - proves fkPc d q < 1 for d>=2, q>=1 via Bernoulli/FK comparison, unconditional Ising transition
PcUpperPeierls.lean:181 lines - uses outer contour/Peierls to prove fkPc 2 2 < 1 and unconditional 2D transition at betaC
PottsCriticalCorrespondence.lean:170 lines - defines pottsFKMagnetization, proves betaC = -((q-1)/q)log(1-fkPc) for q>1
Q2.lean:228 lines - constructs Ising/q=2 Potts bijection (toIsing), proves weight/Z/prob equivalence, betaOfP/pOfBeta bijection
summary: Inspected all 18 Lean files in the IsingFK directory. Every file contains formal mathematical content: definitions of statistical mechanics concepts (Ising model, FK percolation, Edwards-Sokal measure), theorems establishing correspondences (magnetization-percolation identity, critical point relations), and proofs using GKS inequalities, Peierls arguments, and finite-volume limits. Key results include: beta-p parameter bijections (BetacPc), coloring/compatibility for ES measure (Coloring), correlation monotonicity via GKS2 (CorrelationMonotone), infinite-volume limits (EsInfinite), wired/free boundary equivalences (EsLatticeBridge, EsWired), finite-volume ES correspondence (FvES), box encoding of Ising-FK (HisingBoxClose, IsingBoxEncoding), long-range order assembly (LongRangeOrderAssembly), magnetization-percolation identities (MagPercoId, MagPercoIdBox, MagnetizationCorrespondence), magnetization non-negativity (MagnetizationFK), upper bounds on critical probability for all dimensions (PcUpperAllDimensions) and d=2 via Peierls (PcUpperPeierls), Potts critical correspondence for q>1 (PottsCriticalCorrespondence), and Ising/q=2 Potts bijection (Q2). All files contain unique, non-duplicated mathematical content essential for formal search.
